meta_description: A free Linux app that reads PDFs aloud with natural voices, offline, on your own computer. Follow the highlighted sentence, export to MP3, and read scanned documents with built-in OCR.
hero_lead: A desktop app that reads documents aloud with natural voices — offline, on your own computer.
cta_note: Flatpak · No account · Works without internet
hero_shot_alt: Pagebard reading a PDF aloud, with the current sentence highlighted on the page
why_title: Like a bard reciting the page
why_body: Articles, contracts, class notes: most of what we have to read arrives as a PDF, and our eyes get tired long before the pages end. <mark>Pagebard opens the document, shows every page exactly as it was designed, and reads it to you.</mark>
pillar1_body: Nothing to sign up for. Open a PDF and press Play.
pillar2_body: Nothing you open ever leaves your computer.
pillar3_body: The voices run on an ordinary processor.
features_lead: Articles, contracts, class notes or whole books — sit back and listen at your own pace.
f1_body: The PDF is displayed as it is, not as extracted text.
f2_body: The sentence being spoken is highlighted on the page, and the view scrolls with it.
f3_body: Click a word to begin there, double-click to start at once, or drag to select a passage and hear only that.
f4_body: Piper neural voices in dozens of languages, downloaded on demand.
f5_body: From 0.5× to 2.0×, without changing the pitch.
f6_body: Turn a document, or a range of pages, into an audio file.
f7_body: Built-in text recognition (OCR) for documents that are only pictures.
f8_body: Every command has a shortcut and a menu entry; the interface text can be enlarged.
f9_body: English, Português (Brasil) and Español — and adding another is a single text file.
shot_selection_alt: A selected passage ready to be read aloud
shot_selection_caption: Select a passage to hear only that
shot_voices_alt: The voice manager listing downloadable voices
install_lead: Pagebard is distributed as a single Flatpak file.
step2: Double-click the file. Your software centre opens: choose Install.
install_voice: The first time you press Play, Pagebard offers to download a voice (about 60 MB). After that it works without internet.
install_help_summary: Double-clicking does not open the software centre?

privacy_body: Pagebard never uploads your documents. The network is used only when you ask for a download: a voice, the voice list, or text-recognition data.
contribute_body: Bug reports, ideas and translations are welcome. Adding a language is a single text file.
